music.prompt: Immediate-start top-down pixel RPG cafeteria exploration loop. Calm queue motion, clean ceramic rhythm, short repeating phrases, and enough silence for dialogue and interaction sounds.

music.prompt: Immediate-start alternate dark-mode loop for the same pixel cafeteria. Hidden paper traces become readable through restrained scanner pulses, dry ticking, and a compact unresolved motif.
music.instruments: filtered pulse wave, glass ticks, dry low tom, sparse digital scanner tones

music.prompt: Immediate-start campus bicycle chase loop for a pixel RPG. Fast forward motion, three-lane dodging rhythm, short urgent figures, and clear space for collision and near-miss cues.
music.instruments: tight electronic kick, clipped hi-hats, bright arpeggiator, small bicycle bell accents
